summary: v46b retest of the two HIGH-priority blockers from iteration_21. Backend: 24/24 pytest pass (extended test_v46_vendor_ratings.py with TestPublicRubric + TestDirectory covering the two new endpoints). Frontend: all three fixes verified end-to-end on the preview URL. Confirm whether manualvendor should be flagged is_active=true so verified peers auto-publish in dev — same observation as iteration_21.
critical_code_review_comments: RateAVendor.jsx had `{rubrics.length > 1 && (... pickCriteriaSet ...)}` block referencing symbols that no longer exist after the switch to publicRubric(). This crashed the whole panel — a lint/pre-commit check would have caught it (`no-undef`). Removed the block. Consider adding CI ESLint with react-app config so undefined vars fail the build.
Admin console throws several React hydration warnings (span-in-option and button-in-label inside AnalyticsPanel/InfoDot). Not blocking but noisy — unrelated to v46.

Public rubric endpoint correctly returns 200 with the seeded default rubric and requires no auth; directory endpoint enforces vendor cookie (401 without) and returns 40 rows for the manualvendor caller, excluding self and honouring ?q= + ?limit= cap 500.

rca of the issue: iteration_21 blockers had two causes: (1) public-facing pages calling admin-scoped criteria API and (2) vendor Rate-a-vendor calling admin-scoped vendor-intel summary. E1 added /public/rubric and /directory endpoints and swapped the frontend calls to vendorRatingsApi.publicRubric() and vendorRatingsApi.peerDirectory(). Both fixes work. A leftover conditional block in RateAVendor.jsx (`{rubrics.length > 1 && ...}`) survived the refactor and referenced undefined identifiers — crashed the component on vendor pick with `ReferenceError: rubrics is not defined`. Removed the dead block; peer form now renders and submits successfully.
